notes.title: Supermrket: Zoo
notes.content:
Supermrket expands its Zoo with a new area featuring six different types of apes (including the only Snowflake in the world from Barcelona), and a souvenir area.

- Agendas, T-shirts, Caps, Magnets, Keychains, and Mugs.

notes.title: Supermrket: Anniversary Edition
notes.content: After half a year of starting this humble project, I have decided to culminate this period with a selection of products: gold bars, a computer mouse, a video game controller, a storage disk and a pendrive.
